job.title: Associate Systems Administrator
job.description:
We’re currently recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing global technology business for an Associate Systems Administrator to join its Dublin-based IT Systems team.

This is a great opportunity for an IT professional looking to develop their career within a global environment, working across systems administration, endpoint management, IAM, networking and security.

As the Associate Systems Administrator you will be responsible for:

  • Administer identity platforms such as Okta / OneLogin Support Microsoft Intune / Jamf and endpoint management
  • Helpdesk support
  • Assist with software deployments, patching and OS updates
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall issues
  • Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack
  • Manage user joiner/mover/leaver processes and access controls
  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge-base articles
  • Assist with office networking, AV and infrastructure
  • Participate in an on-call rotation when required

As the Associate Systems Administrator you will have the following experience:

✔️ Experience with IAM ( Okta or OneLogin)
✔️ Familiarity with Intune or Jamf
✔️ Experience using ServiceNow, Jira or similar ticketing platforms
✔️ Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack
✔️ Basic enterprise networking and troubleshooting knowledge
✔️ Strong documentation and communication skills
✔️ Commerical experience in IT support / systems administration

We are offering a hybrid working model, competitive package+ more!

Please contact hello AT Freshtechit.com

job.title: Senior VIP Executive Support
job.description:
Our client, a leading financial organisation are seeking a VIP Executive Support Specialist to provide support to their most senior leaders. This role is a unique hybrid of elite systems engineering and high-touch hospitality, requiring someone who can manage complex technical infrastructures while maintaining the polish and discretion necessary for C-Suite interaction.

You will be the primary technology partner for the Executive Office, ensuring that the firm’s leadership remains connected, secure, and productive, whether in the boardroom, at home, or traveling internationally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Executive Technology Concierge: Act as the dedicated point of contact for C-Suite executives and Board members, providing rapid-response support for hardware, software, and secure remote access.
  • High-Stakes Event Leadership: Own the technical success of Board meetings and high-profile hybrid events, managing enterprise A/V, Zoom/Teams Rooms, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Infrastructure Engineering: Balance daily support with long-term engineering projects, including Intune deployments, PowerShell automation, and Windows-based VDI management.
  • Secure Global Mobility: Provision and secure executive "travel kits," validating international connectivity and VPN protocols to ensure seamless global operations.
  • Tailored Coaching: Provide 1-on-1 technology briefing and "concierge-style" onboarding for new executives, focusing on Microsoft 365 productivity and AI-enabled tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Industry Experience: Solid commercial experience in IT support, with experience of VIP or Executive support capacity (Financial Services or Legal experience is highly preferred).
  • Technical Mastery: Advanced expertise in the Microsoft 365 E5 suite, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Intune/Endpoint Manager.
  • Platform Breadth: Expert-level knowledge of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.
  • Engineering Skills: Hands-on experience with scripting (PowerShell) and Group Policy (GPO) administration.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex cybersecurity and technical concepts into concise, actionable advice for non-technical senior leaders.

Candidate Profile

  • Discretion: You have a proven track record of handling sensitive, confidential information with absolute integrity.
  • Poise: You remain calm and effective in high-pressure situations, such as technical failures during live executive presentations.
  • Proactivity: You don’t wait for tickets; you anticipate technical friction points and resolve them before they impact the leadership team.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to travel on short notice and provide after-hours support during critical executive movements.

We are offering a competitive package + benefits.

The role requires you to be onsite 5 days a week.

Please contact for more details.

job.title: Agentic Software Engineer
job.description:
Agentic Software Engineer
The Opportunity


We’re partnering with a global organisation to hire an Agentic Software Engineer — a role at the forefront of how modern engineering teams operate.

This isn’t traditional software development. You won’t be writing most of the code yourself. Instead, you’ll design, direct, and optimise AI agents that do.

If you’re already working this way — or pushing hard in that direction — this is a chance to take it further in a high-impact, real-world environment.

As the Agentic Software Engineer you will be responsible for:

  • Designing AI-driven engineering workflows where agents handle implementation end-to-end
  • Building systems that allow agents to run autonomously with minimal oversight
  • Creating robust validation frameworks so you can trust output without manual review
  • Enabling multiple agents to work in parallel across complex systems
  • Driving automation across the full development lifecycle (planning → deployment → monitoring)
  • Collaborating directly with stakeholders to rapidly turn ideas into production-ready solutions

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background as a Software Engineer with with a clear shift toward AI-assisted or agent-led development
  • Strong experience writing specs, prompts, and structured context for AI systems
  • Proven ability to validate and productionise AI-generated code
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, APIs, or enterprise systems
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar
  • Exposure to AWS, Node.js, Python, React, TypeScript, GraphQL
  • Experience building custom agent tooling, workflows, or integrations
  • Understanding of cost control and scaling AI usage

The role will be onsite in London ( we do offer 1 day WFH) excellent benefits and career opportunitiea.
